rationale: vertical_fader:draw decided the selected-pattern flicker of the background rows by the on-screen column (x = step - horizontal_offset) but that of the active LED by the absolute step (self.x). On step pages 2-4 of the note and velocity editors the chosen pattern's column therefore showed a steady active LED on the top row (level 12) while page 1 flickered 11/13. The active-LED check now uses the on-screen column, like the row loop. M-PAT-006's page-selection check had pinned the steady level 12 on pattern 3's top-row cell on page 3; it now expects that cell to flicker and keeps the other 15 cells steady.
oracle: README 471: 'The gentle flicker on the top row indicates the currently chosen pattern'; README 461: four 16-step pages; README 485: the velocity editor functions similarly to the note page.
